help.faq.journal-private-photos.question: Zemreɣ ad eḥfeḍeɣ tiwlafin tuffirin?
help.faq.journal-private-photos.subtitle: I uḍfar n kra n ibeddilen yettwalin.
help.faq.journal-private-photos.answer: Ih. Llant tiwlafin tuffirin yettwaḥrazen, d amedya i uḍfar n wamek i d-ttuɣal ibexxan, tirni n yiziwen neɣ tisekkiwin n ugilal.
help.faq.security-private-data.question: Amek i tḥrez AWA isefka-inu?
help.faq.security-private-data.subtitle: Tabaḍnit, taɣellist d ukcam n isefka s wazal.
help.faq.security-private-data.answer: AWA tebna ɣef ukcam n isefka s wazal, war sirem yettwaskanen, war tuzzya n isefka udmawanen, d usekles aɣellsan s uwgelhen ageṣṣad n isefka yelhan.
help.faq.security-export.question: Zemreɣ ad d-ssufɣeɣ isefka-inu?
help.faq.security-export.subtitle: Asufeɣ n PDF d CSV yettwasefrek.
help.faq.security-export.answer: Ih. Illa usufeɣ PDF n uḍfar-ik d usufeɣ CSV n isefka-ik, akken ad tebnuḍ amazray ben, ula i uɛessas n tezmert.
help.faq.security-delete.question: Zemreɣ ad kkseɣ isefka-inu s sshala?
help.faq.security-delete.subtitle: Tukksa teqqim d tafessast u tzemmer ad tawḍeḍ ɣer-s.
help.faq.security-delete.answer: Ih. Tukksa tafessast n isefka-ik d umiḍan-ik tella seg yiɣewwaren yettwaqqnen.
help.guides.getting-started.title: Aɣuru n AWA
help.guides.getting-started.text: Af agdil-ik agejdan, awennaz, ameɣrad, iswi d yiceggiɛen iṛuḥanin.
help.guides.cycle.title: Uḍfar n tawaɣit
help.guides.cycle.text: Sred lḥiḍ-ik, usuḍu, u wali isnaw n tawaɣit-ik.
help.guides.conceive.title: Ɛerḍeɣ ad ḥemleɣ
help.guides.conceive.text: Ḍfer tuẓẓalt, ovulation, tazeggwaɣt tazadurt, cervical mucus d yizmal LH.
help.guides.contraception.title: Contraception
help.guides.contraception.text: Seggem tarrayt-ik, ismektiyen, tikkal i d-nsiɣ d umazray n uṭṭaf.
help.guides.irregular.title: Tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara / PCOS
help.guides.irregular.text: Ẓẓer tiwaɣitin ur nṣeḥḥ ara, ibexxan, tirni n yiziwen, lweznan d tsekkiwin yettwaqqnen.
help.guides.menopause.title: Perimenopause / Menopause
help.guides.menopause.text: Ḍfer hot flashes, yiṣṭṭan, taɛeggunt, wannuz d yizìdiyen n hormone.
help.guides.pregnancy.title: Uḍfar n lḥemla
help.guides.pregnancy.text: Ḍfer azemz n tlalit, ddwṛat, isulayen, inagaren d tsekkiwin.
help.guides.postpartum.title: Deffir tlalit
help.guides.postpartum.text: Ḍfer lochia, tuɣalin n tawaɣit, asfuddu, yiṣṭṭan, wannuz d uɣilif.
help.guides.loss.title: Deffir tuffɣa n lḥemla
help.guides.loss.text: Ḍfer idammen, tisekkiwin, d tuɣalin n tawaɣit-ik s wazal-ik.
help.guides.calendar.title: Aseqdec n uwennaz
help.guides.calendar.text: Fhem lḥiḍ, isnaw, yiceggiɛen, d uskan Grigoryan / Hijri.
help.guides.journal.title: Askemmel n umeɣrad n ass
help.guides.journal.text: Sred tisekkiwin, wannuz, yiṣṭṭan, armud, tizmilin d tuḥeṛmit.
help.guides.spiritual.title: Aseqdec n yiceggiɛen iṛuḥanin
help.guides.spiritual.text: Af awennaz Hijri, ṭṭhara, tseddit, uṣum, qaḍa d nifas.
help.guides.privacy.title: Tabaḍnit & isefka
help.guides.privacy.text: Seggem taɣellist, askar uffir, asufeɣ, uwgelhen d tukksa n isefka.
